resolution_notes: Verifier B is correct on both disputed fields. Official pricing (https://spoonacular.com/food-api/pricing) publishes a free tier of 150 points/day; endpoints are point-weighted rather than a flat request count. The original "unknown" / "not published" values are therefore wrong—limits appear on the pricing page (Free 150/day; paid tiers scale to 1,500–150,000+ points/day). All other fields remain as in the original entry.
free_tier_limits: 150 points/day free (Food API pricing; points are endpoint-weighted, not a flat request count)
rate_limits: Free: 150 points/day; paid plans scale higher (e.g. 1,500–150,000+ points/day). Limits are published on pricing.
